causal_mechanism: The estimator integrates a network functional over a point set on the sphere, so its residual variance decomposes as the sum over even harmonic degrees of the functional's degree-l energy times the design's degree-l defect A_l. For m antipodally doubled orthonormal frames every point sees one inner product at plus one, one at minus one, and two times width-minus-one zeros inside its own doubled frame; the whole question is what the cross-frame block contributes. For mutually unbiased bases every cross inner product has modulus one over sixteen, and the resulting alternating sum very nearly cancels the self and antipode terms: at degree four it cancels them exactly, and only at m equal to 129, because equating the fourth-moment identity to the design requirement clears to a single linear equation in m with one integer root. For Haar-random orthonormal frames the cross-frame rows are marginally uniform on the sphere and the expected normalized Gegenbauer of a uniform direction is zero at every degree above zero, so the cross block contributes NOTHING and A_l collapses to the self-plus-antipode term alone. That is the mechanism, and it is a statement about which carrier is strong: at degree four the random-frame defect is one hundred twenty-eight thirds times the Kerdock one, while at degree six and above both carriers already sit at the reciprocal-point-count law and are indistinguishable. So on the deployed carrier the completion is not a marginal refinement of an already-exact degree; it removes a defect that is currently at full independent-sampling strength. The mechanism therefore has two separable legs and the third arm exists to separate them: entering the structured design family at fixed point count, which is where the degree-four defect actually falls by that factor, and completing the family from 126 frames to 129, which takes the residue to exactly zero and buys three more frames' worth of point count at the price the score law charges. Against all of that stands the collapse mechanism, which is why the gated contrast can go either way: the carrier is not a bare design average. It substitutes exact analytic means for provably dead neurons, composes always-on neurons through exact linear folding, and subtracts a tangent-transported correction whose control is the first layer's exactly known mean and second moment. That control's own harmonic content is the rectifier kink tail, which is weighted toward LOW degree, so the control removes proportionally more degree-four error than high-degree error and the post-control degree-four share can be far below the pre-control one. The measurement decides which of the two dominates, and the exact defect table for all three frame sets rides along in the report so the mechanism is attributable rather than argued.
cheapest_falsifier: Three Public100 harness invocations under one sealed authorization, on the same frozen dataset split, the same one hundred networks in the same order, the same harness seed and the same flop budget, with the three estimator trees byte-identical apart from what setup() builds: arm A the 126 Haar-random orthonormal frames the carrier ships, arm B the 129-frame set formed as the identity basis together with every phased-Hadamard frame the frozen asset carries, arm C the champion's own frozen Kerdock-126 trim of that same asset. All three arms carry the per-network Haar rotation lifted verbatim from the deployed champion, which is distributionally vacuous for random frames and is what makes a fixed deterministic frame set produce independent per-network draws at all; without it the bootstrap over networks would be invalid for arms B and C. Pair per network, form the equal-network-weight ratio of mean per-network adjusted scores, and bootstrap that ratio over networks with a declared seed and a single shared resampling of network indices so the pairing survives into the interval. GATE ON ARM A AGAINST ARM B ONLY, on the FLOP-only score law, with the lawful residual-wall-time channel reported alongside as a co-primary, because residual wall time is machine noise whose size is taken from the archived Public100 runs rather than asserted: on kerdock_v3 the per-network residual share lambda*R_m/C_m has median 4.35% and max 7.25% of effective compute (kerdock_v3_official100.json, 100 networks), and on the deployed row-blocked carrier the aggregate share is 8.46% (ROW_BLOCKED_WINOGRAD_PRODUCTION_REPORT.md, mean residual 0.160585 s against mean effective C 189.852556B), while billed FLOPs are bit-reproducible. Arm C is reported and never gated: it supplies the design-quality and completion legs, whose logs add exactly to the gated log ratio, so it is an accounting of the measured quantity rather than a third comparison against the margin. If the bootstrap interval on the gated ratio lies wholly above one minus the declared margin, the completion cannot deliver a gain of the declared size on this carrier, the larger public claim does not transfer, and the campaign's own break-even is confirmed on a premise that is now both stronger and powered.
equal_budget_baseline: Arm A IS the equal-budget baseline, and it is the shipped carrier rather than a reconstruction: the same seven source files, byte-identical across all three arms except estimator.py, hash-frozen at predeclare and re-hashed at run. Equality is not of point count -- the whole gate is that arm B spends more points -- but of everything the score law does not already price. Same frozen dataset directory, same split, same n-mlps, same subprocess runner, same harness seed, same flop budget, same residual-penalty rate, same host, same interpreter, back to back in one process. Same estimator constants: dead-alpha, on-alpha, pilot base, fold pilot base, the tangent coefficient, radial conditioning on, the row-blocked Winograd block height. Same per-network Haar rotation, keyed by the network's own seed, in ALL THREE arms, so the frame set is the single manipulated variable. Arm C additionally holds the point count equal to arm A exactly, which is what makes its leg a clean design-quality contrast with no cost channel moving. The point-count difference between arm A and arm B is not controlled away because the adjusted score charges for it exactly: the cost ratio enters the gated statistic through the harness's own per-network multiplier, and the reciprocal-point-count law makes a pure point-count increase land at unity by construction, which is the null this cell is powered against. Arm C also builds its directions explicitly, exactly as arms A and B do, rather than through the champion's phase-and-butterfly memory fold, so the three arms bill the same first-product arithmetic; the memory fold is a separate mechanism with its own record and is deliberately out of scope here.
hypothesis: The 129-frame real mutually-unbiased-basis completion, which drives the antipodally doubled design's degree-four defect to exactly zero, delivers a materially better adjusted score than the 126 Haar-random orthonormal frames the row-blocked carrier currently ships, measured on the same one hundred public networks and paired per network, after paying the point-count cost the score law charges for the three extra frames. That contrast, arm A against arm B, is the ONE gated question. A third arm rides along, gated by nothing: the Kerdock-126 design built from the same frozen phase asset, at arm A's point count and arm B's design family, which splits the gated contrast into a design-quality leg and a completion leg without adding a second test. Two prior campaign records bear on the gated question and neither settles it. m81 and s11 measured the completion against a Kerdock baseline whose degree-four defect was ALREADY suppressed far below the independent-sampling level, found the degree-four-attributable reduction an order of magnitude under the break-even, and did so at a between-network power that a later adversarial audit put at the type-one rate, i.e. none. The premise change here is the CARRIER and the POWER together, and both are declared: the deployed row-blocked carrier's frames are random orthonormal, not mutually unbiased, so its degree-four defect sits AT the independent-sampling level rather than far below it, and the contrast is run paired on one hundred networks under one harness seed rather than on three networks. Two public reports disagree by more than an order of magnitude about what completion is worth -- one near a fifth of mean squared error against a Kerdock baseline, the other near one part in a hundred -- and the baseline carrier's degree-four defect is exactly the quantity that would separate them. PASS means the completion clears the declared margin on our carrier and the larger public claim transfers to it. KILL means the powered measurement excludes a gain of that size, which confirms the break-even our own records assert and refutes the transfer.
inconclusive_band_note: The gated metric is a two-sided studentized distance from the declared margin, computed from ARM A AND ARM B ONLY: the equal-network-weight FLOP-only adjusted-score ratio's log, minus the log of one minus the margin, divided by the bootstrap standard error of that log. PASS at or below the negative critical value means the whole interval clears the margin on the good side; KILL at or above the positive critical value means the whole interval clears it on the bad side; the band between is a genuine straddle. THE THIRD ARM IS NOT PART OF THE GATE AND MUST NOT BE READ INTO IT. Arm C is a reported decomposition co-primary: its design-quality and completion legs are emitted with their own intervals, but neither leg is compared against the margin, neither can produce a disposition, and the judge must not record a PASS or KILL on a leg. The gate is one pre-registered comparison, not a three-way search for whichever contrast happens to clear a threshold; a decomposition that looks favourable while the gated contrast straddles is an INCONCLUSIVE cell with an informative decomposition, and nothing more. Arm C is nonetheless held to the same structural integrity checks as arms A and B -- no failed networks, off the score-multiplier floor, identical network order, finite positive entries -- and a violation there is a fail-closed protocol kill, because the three arms run back to back on one host under one authorization and a structural failure in any of them impugns the environment the other two ran in. The metric shape has one structural virtue the judge must read: NOISE MOVES THE METRIC TOWARD ZERO, never toward KILL, so an underpowered run lands INCONCLUSIVE and can never counterfeit a powered null. The judge MUST copy six things into the disposition record, because the single stored scalar cannot carry them: the gated score ratio and its interval; the bootstrap standard error, which IS the achieved power and is the quantity the mub129 post-mortem died for want of; the lawful residual-inclusive co-primary and whether it agrees in sign; the per-network billed-FLOP ratio spread on both the A-to-B and A-to-C pairs, which is the named confound's instrument; the two decomposition legs with the design-quality share of the log gain; and the H1 band and falsifier flags, which are a pre-registered prior scored against outcome and carry no gate authority. Two outcomes are NOT dispositions and must not be recorded as such: any failed network in any arm, or a network on the score-multiplier floor, exits the runner nonzero, because a zeroed prediction is not a measurement and the break-even premise does not exist at the floor. The margin is on the ADJUSTED score, not on raw MSE, so a raw-MSE improvement smaller than the point-count cost correctly reads as a loss; that is the score law, not a threshold choice. A KILL here confirms m81 and s11 a fortiori: it kills the completion on a carrier where the degree-four defect was at full strength, which is strictly harder to kill on than the Kerdock carrier they tested. A PASS supersedes them only on the declared carrier premise and authorizes nothing beyond a separately frozen build stage, because the completion's memory increment on this carrier is an undischarged blocker in its own right.
